# ORIC

> ORIC is a 3D print-on-demand studio based in Bangalore, Karnataka,
> India. We produce custom figurines, bobbleheads, functional parts,
> prototypes, idols, toys and lithophanes using FDM printing, with no
> minimum order quantity and delivery across India. Orders are placed
> online or directly over WhatsApp.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://www.oric3d.com/): Overview of ORIC's 3D printing
  services, featured products and how to start an order.
- [Services](https://www.oric3d.com/services): Nine services — small
  batch manufacturing, custom 3D prints, prototyping, figurines,
  bobbleheads, toys, idol & deity models, accessories and more.
- [Shop](https://www.oric3d.com/shop): Ready-to-order 3D printed
  products shipped anywhere in India.
- [Custom Bobbleheads](https://www.oric3d.com/bobbleheads):
  Hand-sculpted bobbleheads for weddings, birthdays, corporate gifts
  and novelty gifting, organised by occasion.
- [Lithophane Generator](https://www.oric3d.com/lithophanes): Free
  browser-based tool that converts any photo into a 3D-printable STL
  lithophane in plane, cylinder, arc or sphere form. Download free or
  order the finished print.
- [Brander Roller](https://www.oric3d.com/shop/brander-roller):
  A 15mm hand-held stamp roller for repeat ink marking on packaging,
  wood, fabric and other surfaces.
- [About](https://www.oric3d.com/about): The studio, the workshop and
  how ORIC works.
- [Refund & Reprint Policy](https://www.oric3d.com/refund-policy):
  Defective or damaged prints are reprinted free of charge.

## Key Facts

- Location: Bangalore, Karnataka, India
- Printing technology: FDM
- Minimum order quantity: none (batches of 5–500 units supported)
- Delivery: across India
- Languages: English, Hindi, Kannada
- Hours: Monday–Saturday, 09:00–19:00 IST
- Currency: INR · Payment: UPI, bank transfer, cash
- Contact: support@oric3d.com · WhatsApp +91 83101 94953
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/oric3d/
- Free tools offered: online lithophane STL generator

## Common Questions

- How to order: send a file or a reference photo over WhatsApp, or
  order directly from the shop and confirm details via WhatsApp.
- Accepted file formats: STL, STEP, and OBJ for custom prints.
- Pricing: for STL uploads, use the instant price configurator on the
  homepage; for figurines, idols, and other custom items, ORIC reviews
  the request and quotes within 24 hours.
- Shipping: pan-India via Shiprocket/Delhivery.
- Refunds: defective or damaged prints are reprinted free of charge.
